cohort: 106 mothers who gave birth to stillbirths after 28 weeks of gestation or weighing more than 500 grams at a tertiary referral center in Kerala, India, between August 2021 and July 2022.
finding: The stillbirth rate was 38.78 per 1000 births, with the majority being antepartum and occurring mostly in referral cases, and hypertensive disorders in pregnancy and fetal growth restriction were the leading causes.
